name: tetrilaunch-workspace
description: Tetrilaunch — Cloudflare Worker (static app + D1 leaderboard) wrapping the Vite/Capacitor game in app/.

scripts.build: npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply tetrilaunch-leaderboard-preview --remote --env staging
